cases.refreshed: Looking for cute, fun, creative, and crafty wares? Check out the ARTrepreneur: Teen Craft Fair. All teens featured at this fair have completed the ARTrepreneur program and are small business owners. Come support them and check out their incredible products. Cash and most payment apps accepted. No obligation to purchase. The Fair will be held during the TeenHQ Theater Production. Fuzzy and Fluffy is among the scheduled vendors and will sell popular crocheted items, including loaf cats, octopi, and chickens. Its keychains include mini octopuses, mushroom pops, and mini chickens. These items are perfect as birthday or holiday gifts, or even room decor! We're looking forward to meeting you at our market! Welcome to Green Apple Boutique! We are a small business located in the Bay Area and would love to have you as a part of our community! Our shop is currently focusing on the production of pins and jewelry but we plan to expand our inventory to cute stationery in the future! Lils Creations features handmade jewelry, customized stationery, beadable pens, unique keychains and charms. Designed with care, high-quality materials, and a touch of character-inspired charm, my items are crafted to offer thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts and accessories. Calderon & Co's business is the amalgamation of a love for toys, 3D printing, and making money. The goal was to create a toy that could satisfy the urge to fidget or imagine new, forbearing the spontaneous horrors of a bored mind, without being a traditional, hyper-consumeristic toy that serves little purpose beyond draining your wallet. Three main problems were identified, alongside a single solution: affordable toys suck, they don't keep people still, and the CEO of C&C is very broke. The solution? A selection of 3D-printed fidget toys, tested profusely. What makes this selection unique is that people of all ages can come to the table and try the fidgets firsthand. Every effort is made to ensure product quality through careful selection of what gets sold, and by personally breaking them in so the initial rough texture is ameliorated as much as possible. Aydraw Art's crafts and creations take the ease- and add some style. We create practical trinkets such as beautiful handmade keychains, pipe cleaner flowers, cards, cups, jewelry bowls, and so much more all to inspire your creative flame! For reasonable prices add some bling and express your individuality and creativity today! Two Tiny Potatoes sells yarn-crafted items including star wands, keychains, flower hair clips, arm cuffs, coasters, and hand warmers. Forever Flowers blends the beauty of bouquets with everlasting love from crocheting, which makes it the perfect gift for yourself or others to commemorate a moment with. Forever Flowers offers a wide range of crocheted products from flowers, coasters, plants and more that can be used for many different purposes. At Earthwise Pens, we believe in being as environmentally friendly as possible, without making the product expensive. Our products have the same level of quality as other products, and the same price, but eco-friendly. Meghna's Nails sells handmade press-on nails. Each set is carefully painted with gel polish, beads, and gems. We bring affordable and convenient nails that are available in a variety of designs, shapes, and sizes straight to you! Great for elevating any outfit, Meghna's nails brings beauty in details! Learn about the ARTrepreneur program and how teens bring their small business dreams to life. Celebrating 10 years of SJPL TeenHQ

By blending structural anatomy with creative "shape language" and storytelling, students will learn how to build characters that feel alive, consistent, and purposeful. Reading Buddies creates a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers and helps children build confidence as readers. cases.refreshed: Our One-on-One Reading Tutor for Kids provides students in grades K-3 with an opportunity to improve their reading skills by working one-on-one with a reading coach. Our reading coach creates a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers and helps children build confidence as readers. Our reading coach will listen to children read and provide support in phonics, sight words, and comprehension. Students can bring their favorite book or choose from the available selection at the Cambrian Branch Library to read aloud to their reading coach. Free. Pre-registration not required. However, reading sessions are available on a first-come, first-served basis and the duration of reading sessions will be 15 minutes. (A slightly longer session may be permitted, provided there are no other participants.) Participants can also use their session to read away their fines! Just inform your coach (open to youth only). Please note that the One-On-One Reading Tutor for Kids is a program to encourage young readers to practice their reading skills with an adult volunteer. (It is not intended as an hour-long tutoring session.)

Are you a senior trying to catch up with the digital world? Would you like to learn how to create an email, to search the internet, to create and edit Microsoft Word documents, to do online job searching or to complete online job applications? Increase your digital literacy today. Our tech mentors can guide you in learning a variety of computer skills that enable you to better use the library's public computers and to benefit from the library's freely available online resources, including ebooks! Don't worry about not having a computer; iPads will be available for in-library use during the mentoring session. Our tech mentor is available on a drop-in schedule. If you have more questions, please call us at 408-808-3053.

cases.refreshed: The Adult & Teen Crafternoon is moving to the 2nd Saturday of the month just for November and December! Patrons ages 13+ are invited to take part in a different craft or art project each month. You are welcome to drop in at any time, but please note most projects will take over 30 minutes to complete. Any demonstrations will take place at the start of the program at 3 PM, though there will be instructions and staff to answer questions at any time. December's craft is Felted Snowmen! Come learn the basics of needle felting to create a cozy winter friend, from a simple snowman for beginner's to a more elaborate snow animal if you'd like to experiment! No registration is required; walk in while supplies last. The program space is for adults and teens (ages 13+) only. Please browse children's events if you are interested in events for younger ages.
